verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents its own natural-language interfaces: a conversational AI assistant that answers questions, summarizes files and generates content, plus semantic AI Search that takes natural language instead of keywords. These cover querying content in natural language, but the evidence does not show users issuing natural-language commands that perform product operations such as sharing, moving or permissioning files. Agents are described as configured, not commanded conversationally. Missing for 10: documented natural-language execution of product actions (file management, sharing, admin tasks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Conversational AI assistant capable of answering questions and summarizing multiple selected files or knowledge bases, and generating content such as emails, memos, proposals, etc.
semantic search across all connected content repositories using natural language rather than keywords.
Now, our brokers can query across multiple documents in natural language to search for terms and conditions and compare files.
